## Install

1. Download **`squat-overflow.zip`** from the assets below and unzip it. You get a folder named `squat-overflow`. Keep it somewhere permanent, such as your Documents folder, because Chrome loads the extension from it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode** (top right), click **Load unpacked**, and pick the `squat-overflow` folder.
3. The settings page opens. Pick your areas and click **Get started**. Breaks use the hosted pose server, so you don't need to run anything else.

## Update without losing your progress

1. Download the new `squat-overflow.zip` and unzip it.
2. Replace the **contents** of your existing `squat-overflow` folder with the new files.
3. On `chrome://extensions`, click the reload icon on Squat Overflow.

Don't click **Remove**: that deletes your XP, streak and badges. Every release keeps the same extension ID, so reloading the same folder keeps your progress.
